3122132.name: Myles Garrett
3122132.blurb: A pass rusher taken first overall by Cleveland in 2017 out of Texas A&M, now in his tenth season and playing for the Rams after Cleveland traded him for draft picks.

3917315.name: Kyler Murray
3917315.blurb: A quarterback taken first overall by Arizona in 2019 out of Oklahoma, now in his eighth season and starting for Minnesota after signing there for the price of a backup.

3918298.name: Josh Allen
3918298.blurb: Buffalo's quarterback, taken seventh overall out of Wyoming in 2018 and now in his ninth season, recently reworked his deal to free about $12 million for this year.

4047646.name: A.J. Brown
4047646.blurb: A wide receiver taken in the second round out of Ole Miss in 2019, now in his eighth season and brought to New England to be their top target.

4241479.name: Tua Tagovailoa
4241479.blurb: A quarterback picked fifth overall by Miami in 2020 out of Alabama, now in his seventh season with Atlanta after Miami took a record financial hit to move on from him.

4242512.name: Malik Willis
4242512.blurb: A quarterback taken in the third round by Tennessee in 2022, now in his fifth season and signed by Miami for $67.5 million to run their offense after years as a backup.

4360499.name: Tyler Linderbaum
4360499.blurb: A center, the lineman who snaps the ball to start each play, drafted 25th overall by Baltimore in 2022 and now in Las Vegas on the richest deal ever given to an inside offensive lineman.

4426405.name: Trent McDuffie
4426405.blurb: A cornerback taken in the first round by Kansas City in 2022 out of Washington, traded to the Rams for four picks and paid among the very best at his position.

4433970.name: J.J. McCarthy
4433970.blurb: A young quarterback Minnesota picked tenth overall out of Michigan in 2024, and who has since been benched in favour of a cheaper signing.

4575431.name: Devon Witherspoon
4575431.blurb: A cornerback whose job is covering opposing receivers, picked fifth overall by Seattle in 2023 and just re-signed there for $132 million over four years.

4578085.name: Jared Verse
4578085.blurb: A pass rusher the Rams picked in the first round out of Florida State in 2024, now in Cleveland after being part of a trade for one of the league's top defenders.

4592837.name: Terrion Arnold
4592837.blurb: A cornerback Detroit picked in the first round out of Alabama in 2024 who, for reasons unrelated to football, joined Seattle for the league minimum salary.
